entries.label: Role inventory, attributes, skills, and starting pet
acceptanceWitnesses: public fixture-disabled startup tests; not bridge-free generalization evidence

entries.label: C and Lua level construction
acceptanceWitnesses: public fixture-disabled level witnesses; no sealed gate
entries.openGap: Special-level operations, ordinary room fill, startup objects, and unseen Lua variants remain incomplete.

entries.label: Hero, monster, and global-turn scheduler
acceptanceWitnesses: test/bridge_free.test.js: no-actor quiet-role maintenance plus live Samurai and three live Rogue actor/scheduler carriers
entries.openGap: Samurai and three Rogue carriers have public bridge-free actor-rich witnesses; Friday-the-13th run continuation, Priest, broader actor/terrain branches, and a sealed gate remain open.

entries.label: Samurai pet turns, altar run, and prayer occupation
acceptanceWitnesses: test/bridge_free.test.js: seed0017 pet, run, prayer, RNG, screen, and cursor parity with zero bridge hits; public regression only
entries.openGap: The represented bridge-free Samurai path uses live dog_move and prayer turns, but wider candidate, combat, interruption, terrain, and sealed-corpus coverage is absent; legacy scoring still retains its compatibility bridge.

entries.label: Rogue and Rogue-Orc actor scheduling
acceptanceWitnesses: test/bridge_free.test.js: seed0077 chargen, seed1500 pet/dart-trap, and seed0060 orc combat/run parity with zero bridge hits; public regressions only
entries.openGap: Three represented Rogue paths use live source-ration and actor/trap scheduling, but the Friday-the-13th carrier diverges when its first run should continue after a distant squeaky-board sound; save/restore and sealed strata remain unverified.

entries.label: Priest passive projectiles and extended commands
acceptanceWitnesses: live projectile unit witnesses plus public seed0106 regression
entries.openGap: Passive projectile timing and the extended-command sweep still cross recorded boundary replay and snapshot painting.

entries.label: TTY display, cursor, and input-boundary capture
acceptanceWitnesses: focused terminal serialization tests and bridge-free live capture
entries.openGap: Snapshot painters remain in legacy mode and the full tty/window surface has no sealed bridge-free gate.

entries.label: Level transitions, save/restore, and bones
acceptanceWitnesses: public multi-segment regressions; not sealed bridge-free evidence
entries.openGap: Fresh save/restore chains and bones have not been exercised by a sealed bridge-free corpus.
